Name: Batch Geode Cracking
Author: Dominikkovi
Description:
[size=4][b]Batch Geode Cracking.[/b][/size]
[b][size=2]A simple mod that lets you crack multiple geodes at the same time.[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]Important: It can only crack geodes, not Mystery Boxes![/b][/size]
[line]
[size=4][b]
[b]Installation[/b][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] — Make sure you have version 4.0.0 or higher.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] [i](recommended)[/i] — Allows you to change all settings from inside the game.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Download and extract[/b] — Place the [i][b]RandomizedBundles[/b][/i] folder into your [b][i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i][/b] directory.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Launch the game[/b] — Run through [b][i]StardewModdingAPI.exe. [/i][/b]Bundles are generated the first time you load a save.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.0 or higher[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b][b]Credits[/b][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]ConcernedApe — For the 1.6 update that made modding these systems more stable and flexible.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]The SMAPI Community — For documentation on asset editing and save data systems.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Batch Geode Cracking
Manifest.Description: Click any geode in the Clint menu to crack all geodes of that type at once. Uses accurate drop tables and deducts the correct gold cost automatically. Includes Clint jealousy support for players married to Emily.
Manifest.Author: Axis
